assertion: Inline and file SVG images resolve raster and vector resources, preserveAspectRatio meet/slice/none, explicit clipping, pixelated sampling and parent transforms.

browser.reason: Reviewed all three browsers. WebKit applies the image preserveAspectRatio slice and clipping as specified; Chromium instead retains the referenced SVG fit. Firefox differs only in raster/color rounding. Browser page embeds the file markup because image-document security blocks nested file loads.
